documents.title: Blackstone Night Freight: Route Sheet
documents.location: Original sheet at Iron Junction's freight desk; ordinary read interaction
documents.text:
BLACKSTONE NIGHT FREIGHT

Beyond the Junction, take the upper service line to the Blackstone platform. Goods are received through the station service room. Lower freight is entered separately.

Reference account: 4117.

Return traffic: Iron Junction. Do not enter the lower line on a goods waybill.
documents.knowledge_receipt: actual original page read -> MQ05 stage20; route only, not Rider identity or family knowledge

documents.text:
LOWER FREIGHT APPROACH

Use the service pass at the marked door.
If the pass reader is unavailable, use the local mechanical release beside it.

Beyond the door: freight vestibule and return access to the upper platform.
The inhabited levels are farther below.

Close the service door after passage. Do not obstruct the upper return route.

documents.title: Mara's Field Note
documents.location: Original folded note left with the register, readable whether Mara is available or not
documents.text:
The complete register stays together. My name stays in it.

I knew the person entered as Fifth Rider. I have reason to believe that Rider's family came from the place below, called The Deep. That is a lead, not a family tree. The records there may establish what I cannot.

The Rider's recent field work and a family's earlier history are different questions. Do not let anyone answer both with one page.

Mara Vale
documents.knowledge_receipt: actual note read -> separate note receipt56; it does NOT identify this player, set spoken receipt50 or turn the family statement into a personal verified fact

nodes.text: The freight didn't come out of an empty mountain. People live below. And I have reason to believe your family came from there. Not your whole life. Not a story I get to tell you about who you ought to be. A place you can ask questions.

canonical_limits: No fifth principal faction, inherited power, predetermined moral character or player ethnicity/appearance/parents/childhood supplied.
Mara's exact past and involvement in the targeted 2316 memory removal remain unresolved. No flashback or new account of why/how self-erasure occurred.
The family-origin statement remains a bounded attributed claim pending later evidence. The field note refers to the Fifth Rider, not magically to whichever actor reads it.
No original current road outcome, relief stock, report, faction allegiance or save is changed by this writing packet.
No implicit essential/invulnerable actor, compulsory combat, timer, automatic betrayal or offscreen destroyed evidence.
Documentary progression when Mara unavailable does not claim her alive or say the player met/recruited her.
